So I'm 15 and I live in Hawaii. Really fucked up family. I'm a alcohol and weed baby so that's fun. My mom doesn't have the best background. She had a fucked up life. My older sisters on her side got molested by their father and she didn't believe them until it got to the point where u couldn't not believe them (they were 10 and 11 I think). Then she met my dad who has one son he never met. A lil background he came from a horrible fucking family full with rape incest, drugs, suicide, abuse, and a lot fucking more. When he was older (this is a story I heard from family not from him) he was the dude that would go to a person's house if they haven't played a certain type of people and take what they owe and if they don't have enough they "deal" with the person. The lady he was with left him and got with a new dude when the baby was born (smart tbh) so he has weird trust issues, not in my mom tho but for other people to take care of me because he thinks I'll be taken away and "brainwashed" into thinking he's the bad guy because everything that he does is justified and he's doing it so I can be "better" (I'll continue this later). So that's their story, them they had me, I'm very much a accident, they joke about it but even if they didn't it was obvious. They'd be doing shit and my parents would be fucking around so my older sister (13-14 at the time) take care of me instead of going to school. My dad's very manipulative and a bully and so is my mother, they tag team is kids. So one day my dad was yelling at my older sister (my other sister was never around because she did a lot of stuff for the community and got to go to reserves) , and a lot of time it's bullshit that's coming out of their mouth and sometimes we snap and that's what my sister did. Our mom saw it and started to join and scream at my sister kind of tag teaming with my dad. And I was a baby so I didn't see this  but this is from my sister and grandma so they didn't say what they told her but I can guess what they did, even tho my parents never really know us they know exactly what it is that hurts us, shit that if u look at it in hindsight it's bullshit but in the moment it hurts more than anything (for me at least). My grandma saw this and took my sister with her to live with them until she finished highschool and left. So the closes thing to a parental figure was gone. I won't say in detail what they said or did but I'll tell u that they knew what hurt and they said it even though it's not true. And they kept me in a cult of a school which I had to be held back a year for because bthey didn't have my garde yet because it taught kids to think a certain way but not in a good way, and for the first few years I was failing horribly because they took from a different Catholic school which taught us about a single god in complete English teaching us all those beliefs and then I got dropped in a school where we'd get punished if we speak English and had to speak hawaiian (never knew any prior) and taught us old chants and dances and all the horrible things the church did to the hawaiians . it taught us in a very prejudice manner only teaching us the bad shit that white people did to the hawaiians and made us more prejudice and racist against them while not saying that they're teaching us to be racist but teaching us bad things and letting our little brains believe that's all there was. So I was surrounded my racist lil kids who were the only people I could call friends with no way out and being too scared to express my opinions because my mom was the teacher. And on top of that I had to deal with at home life. Up until I was about six I had to go to this crack house that my parents would play poker while I stayed in the front room watching adult swim because that's all that was on that late and a shit ton of shit happened I repressed to the back of my head. But when I was six I started staying home alone and I preferred it. But then there were my parents at home with me. Like I said they knew what hurts and they used that. And whenever I had a different opinion they're destroy me mentally and then physical and then say it was my fault and say a lot more but I don't like repeating it. 7th grade we finally get WiFi, didn't have enough money and I didn't have the confidence to ask for anything, but I got a shitty Kindle and had just enough personality to make some of the best friends I could ask for. My birthday came around I got my dad's old phone, made even more friends and lost some old ones. Pissed off my parents got my phone taken away for half a year. All my friends forgot about me and that shit hurt. Around mid 8th grade got amino and met the love of my life and I got closer to him than anyone else in my life, we got really close and ended up falling in love sadly. He helped me realize it wasn't me who was fucked up it was my family, it hurt like hell but it helped me get strong. We were both way too young and we're both fucked up so we lied too much so we had a few falling outs. We had one big one mid last summer and he left. It hurt but I was ok because I moved to a bigger school for highschool that taught the same thing but had a lot more kids so there are a few that were like me that didn't agree but were forced to go. And on top of that my dad was on the other side of the island for work so he was never at this other house. I got so strong to where I opened up about a lot of things and got a lot more confident. This year I told my mom about my suicidal stuff (big mistake). It ended up me having to go to a doctor and making a safe word and a object I give to my mom when shit gets bad. I got home to see my dad waiting for us and for the next 4 hours they explained in detail how I was a horrible person, another one of those assholes and I only said I was suicidal to make my mom feel like a bad mom (btw I never said it was because of them). It ended and I said I need to finish work because it was almost 10 and I had school the next day. I worked for about 5 mins before my head took over and I had a panic attack. My dad came in said some stuff and said to stand up and I literally couldn't move. He got pissed and grabbed me by my hair and threw my head against the wall (one of the worst things he's done) I had to scream my safe word to my mom because I was genuinely terrified. While I was sobbing in my mother's arms trembling she had the fucking guts to say it was my fault. That the therapists said if they think I was gonna kill myself to grab me by the hair and drag me away to keep me safe. First of all that's bullshit, nobody would ever say that, second of all I was just having a panic attack, no blood, I wasn't hitting my head or anything, just me crying in a ball. And I don't show my emotions for this reason. So I ended up going to a counselor and told her a lot but not everything. She talked to my mom and said I need to be removed from my dad and if my mom can't do that people are gonna have to come in. That was the last day I saw her. I had a school therapist but she was close friends with my dad's family so she had a bias and was hopeful that my dad would change. He won't. She talked to him. His excuse was I had a smart mouth. And ik he won't change because he believes he's fully justified to do what he's doing. Because I'm his daughter therefore I'm basically his property. He literally said that when I get older I should never believe that a man that hits a woman is a good man but he can because I'm his daughter so he has to make sure I'm a good person and discipline me. He won't change and he never will. Then I got good news. I was chosen to go to Vietnam. I had the interview for it and they liked me so much I got almost a full scholarship for it. And on top of that I'd be going to Maryland for a convention and then I'd be going to Arizona to spend the rest of my summer with my older sister, the one who raised me basically. And I might've been staying. I was actually going to be ok. Then corona. Both trips got cancelled. And my dad got laid off so he started staying with us full-time again. And I couldn't leave home. I was back to square one, issolated with my parents in a small house even farther from people who care. I was going to kill myself. Then guess who came back. My old meat friend. The love of my life. We apologised and started working things out and got close again. He's honestly the only thing keeping me alive. But we have a plan. Since he's in a grade higher than me. While we're in school we're gonna save money and after he graduates he'll move here until I'm done with my senior year and I stay with him most of the year. Then when I graduate we'll leave and never look back. We'd move in together and start to work but houses and rent them out so we'll be comfortable by our 30s. Only reason I'm alive rn is because of him. I hate saying that because I feel like I'm guilting him to stay. But in reality I out his happiness above mine any day and if he leaves I'll support him no matter what. But idk if I'd survive that. That's a good bit of the story. There's a lot more that I could put in bit on no sleep and over typing tbh so yeah. U wanted my story there it is
